en_title: 'Physical Books, But Not Physical Games?' — PlayStation Book Announcement Prompts Confusion Over Sony's Physical Media Stance
cn_title: 索尼实体书引发玩家对光盘政策的质疑
subtitle: 支持实体书，却不支持实体游戏？
opus_summary: 索尼推出回顾PlayStation三十年历史的实体书，开放预订后引发玩家质疑。公司此前决定从2028年起削减游戏光盘产量，玩家批评其对待实体媒介的立场。

paragraphs.en: Preorders have opened for PlayStation: The First 30 Years, a physical book honoring the gaming giant’s tenured history, but fans aren't exactly in a celebratory mood. The book’s announcement comes as Sony faces continued criticism for its decision to cut disc production , prompting confusion over the new physical media release and an influx of “No Disc, No Buy” replies.
paragraphs.cn: 回顾这家游戏巨头悠久历史的实体书《PlayStation: The First 30 Years》已开放预订，但粉丝们似乎并没有庆祝的心情。索尼削减光盘产量的决定仍在持续招致批评，此时公布这本实体书，让玩家感到困惑，评论区也涌入了大量「无光盘，不购买」的回复。

paragraphs.en: The book itself is a collaboration between PlayStation and Read-Only Memory, a UK-based publisher focused on “premium” gaming and world-building books. A widely available Standard edition is listed at $125, while a Deluxe Edition, listed at $325, will only be available in 1994 copies. Both editions are now up for preorder exclusively from Read-Only Memory , shipping this November.
paragraphs.cn: 本书由PlayStation与英国出版商Read-Only Memory合作推出，后者专注于出版有关游戏和世界观构建的「高端」书籍。普通版不限量供应，标价125美元(约合人民币834元)；豪华版标价325美元(约合人民币2168元)，限量1,994册。两个版本目前均已在Read-Only Memory独家开放预订，将于今年11月发货。

paragraphs.en: According to the official listing , the 400-page book “is the definitive visual chronicle of Sony’s world-changing videogame console, marking its 30th anniversary with unprecedented access to the company’s archive of R&D prototypes, concept sketches, and development models.” It collects “insights from the engineers and designers who shaped PlayStation’s identity,” including the “Father of PlayStation,” Ken Kutaragi, the original DualShock designer, Teiyu Goto, and the chief designer on the PS5, Yujin Morisawa.
paragraphs.cn: 据官方商品页面介绍，这本400页的书「以权威图像史的形式，记录了索尼这款改变世界的游戏主机。为纪念其诞生30周年，本书以前所未有的权限查阅公司档案，收录了研发原型、概念草图和开发模型」。书中汇集了「塑造PlayStation品牌特色的工程师和设计师们的见解」，受访者包括「PlayStation之父」久多良木健、初代DualShock设计师后藤祯祐，以及PS5首席设计师森泽由仁。

paragraphs.en: Sneak peek images show early designs of DualShock controllers and PlayStation consoles — complete with beautiful disc drives.
paragraphs.cn: 先行公布的图片展示了DualShock手柄和PlayStation主机的早期设计——主机上还配有漂亮的光驱。

paragraphs.en: Fans were quick to point out the curious decision to celebrate the gaming brand’s history with a physical media release. “Just selling collectibles and taking away what we actually want to collect,” said one X user with a sequence of disc emojis. “Just so we’re clear… You support physical books, but not physical games?” replied another.
paragraphs.cn: 粉丝们很快指出，选择以实体媒介来纪念这个游戏品牌的历史，实在令人费解。一位X用户配上一串光盘表情，写道：「只顾着卖收藏品，却拿走了我们真正想收藏的东西。」另一位用户回复道：「我确认一下……你们支持实体书，却不支持实体游戏？」

paragraphs.en: Earlier this year, Sony announced that it would be cutting disc production for PlayStation consoles starting in 2028. Despite immediate backlash, Sony has stood by the decision. But gamers refuse to back down, taking over the comment sections on pretty much anything PlayStation-related .
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，索尼宣布将从2028年起削减PlayStation主机游戏光盘的产量。尽管这一消息立即引发反对，索尼仍坚持原有决定。但玩家们也不肯退让，几乎所有与PlayStation有关的内容，其评论区都被抗议声占据。

paragraphs.en: While the online backlash is louid, it remains to be seen whether it will affect future launches of physical collectibles, digital games, or even the PS6. Ken Kutaragi, who is featured in the new book, recently backed the studio’s decision , acknowledging that “physical discs have become a metaphor for ‘owning’ games” but ultimately seeing the decision to cut production as “economically reasonable.”
paragraphs.cn: 尽管网上的反对声很大，但这是否会影响今后实体收藏品、数字游戏乃至PS6的推出，仍有待观察。参与本书的久多良木健近日支持了索尼的决定。他承认「实体光盘已成为「拥有」游戏的象征」，但最终仍认为削减产量的决定「在经济上是合理的」。

paragraphs.en: While PlayStation has seen a continued decline in physical disc sales , critics argue that “ownership” is an essential part of gaming communities . Building up your physical game collection has long been a source of pride for any PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo fan, while also allowing for sharing and re-selling.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管PlayStation实体光盘销量持续下滑，批评者仍认为，「所有权」是游戏社区不可或缺的一部分。对PlayStation、XBOX或任天堂的粉丝来说，不断扩充自己的实体游戏收藏，长期以来都是值得自豪的事；实体游戏也能与人分享或转售。

paragraphs.en: Former PlayStation boss Shawn Layden has been one voice speaking out against the business decision, saying, “If you can't sell a thing, it means you don't own a thing. If you don't own it, then what are you buying?” As PlayStation continues to look back on its 30-year-history, it’s clear that this decision will define its future.
paragraphs.cn: 前PlayStation负责人Shawn Layden也是公开反对这一商业决定的人之一。他说：「如果一件东西不能卖，就意味着它不属于你。如果你不拥有它，那你买的究竟是什么？」PlayStation仍在回顾自己的30年历史，但显然，这项决定将决定它未来的走向。
